definition: an uncultured or brutish person; a member of a people seen as savage
hook: The Greeks had a word for foreigners. They built it out of mockery of how foreigners talk.
modernAnchor: We picture a barbarian as a sword-swinging brute at the gates. The Greeks just heard an accent.

origin.originalMeaning: one who babbles, a non-Greek speaker

journey: To Greek ears, foreign languages sounded like meaningless noise - a stream of bar bar bar.
So they coined barbaros for any non-Greek speaker. The word is the sound of an accent.
At first it simply meant foreign. After the Persian wars, it curdled into something far crueler.
Rome borrowed it. Europe kept it. A word for not speaking Greek became a word for being savage.
